playerStats.title: My statistics
playerStats.subtitle: How you are playing, across every round and course by course
playerStats.notOfficial: This index is the app's own calculation from your rounds. It is not your official federation handicap: it leaves out the adjustment for each day's playing conditions.
playerStats.emptyDescription: As soon as you finish a full round, you will start seeing how you play here
playerStats.emptyCourseTitle: No complete rounds on this course
playerStats.emptyCourseDescription: Only rounds finished with the whole card count
playerStats.roundsWithoutTee_one: Calculated over {{counted}} of your {{count}} round: the other has no tee recorded, and without it there is no way to measure how hard the course played.
playerStats.roundsWithoutTee_other: Calculated over {{counted}} of your {{count}} rounds: the rest have no tee recorded, and without it there is no way to measure how hard the course played.
playerStats.noRoundsWithTee_one: Your round has no tee recorded, and without it there is no way to measure how hard the course played.
playerStats.noRoundsWithTee_other: None of your {{count}} rounds have a tee recorded, and without it there is no way to measure how hard the course played.
playerStats.estimatedIndexExplained: It comes from your best rounds, not all of them: it says what you are capable of, not the level you have been playing at. With few rounds it is calculated from your best one, so it is slow to reflect a bad run.
